What's the last day FunkNetz has to receive my cancellation, and when does it end then?

response.text:
Your cancellation for FunkNetz (FunkNetz Smart M) must **arrive by Wed 14 Oct 2026**, and it would then end the contract on **Sat 14 Nov 2026** [contract:ctr_fyt9k994t9q2].

A few notes:
- Note today is 2026-10-30, so this deadline has already passed [contract:ctr_fyt9k994t9q2].
- To be safe, Ordnung's rule suggests sending any cancellation about 4 business days before the arrival deadline — in this case by Thu 8 Oct 2026 — but since that's gone too, any cancellation now would just need to arrive as soon as possible [contract:ctr_fyt9k994t9q2].
- After the minimum term, you can cancel at any time with one month's notice, at no cost, per § 56 Abs. 3, 4 TKG [contract:ctr_fyt9k994t9q2].
- Cancellations count only when they **arrive**, not when sent (§ 130 BGB) [contract:ctr_fyt9k994t9q2].

If you still want to cancel, you can draft a cancellation letter in Ordnung — just note the exact end date will now depend on when it actually arrives, since the 14 Oct 2026 deadline has passed.
